author: Amanda Lyons
content: Dancing Cubs were fantastic. They were easy to deal with and answered all of my questions. On the day of the party both the delivery and pick up of the soft play and tables/chairs was quick and efficient. The delivery men were super friendly and helpful. Regarding the equipment itself, everything was great quality and very well kept. The kids all had an amazing time and enjoyed all of the toys that they played with. The children's tables and chairs were incredibly cute and looked great in the room. I would definitely recommend them and would happily use them again for my next children's party.
